verdict.rationale: Proa documents typed Rust components that can be themed and composed (proa-docs-7, proa-docs-15) and vendored into your repo as owned source (proa-docs-6). Components can hold local reactive state: adding signals and event handlers turns one into a hydrated island with its own seed state and a small JS module (proa-gh-3, proa-docs-16). Composition into larger UIs is supported through Suspense boundaries and the shared WebContext (proa-docs-17, proa-docs-18). Missing for 10: detailed docs on the component-local state API and how state passes between composed parents and children, and independent or hands-on corroboration (local state appears limited to hydrated islands).
